messages.author: 4f6f5f995ee31178
messages.subject: knitr output within prezi?
parts:
Hi!

I'd like to create an interactive poster (sometimes called eposter)
(i.e. http://www.ascb.org/ascbpost/index.php/compass-points/item/150-how-to-use-prezi-to-make-a-dynamic-eposter-talk)

in which some sections consisted of knitr output
Would it be possible to include output  from knitr
i.e. such as
http://rpubs.com/gallery/googleVis
or at least just including animated graphics
within prezi?
If not, any suggestion for an alternative to prezi that would let us do that?

The goal is that the user moves around the poster, zooms in wherever considered interesting and take detailed look
at the graphics, best interacting with them.

Thanks

Agus

messages.author: cc1ef8c8158d6b73
messages.subject: Re: [knitr] knitr output within prezi?
parts:
My guess is, no, that is not possible. From my quick understanding of
Prezi, it does not allow interactive content like googleVis (which is
based on JavaScript and Flash). The only "interactive" content that it
supports seems to be videos. Therefore it seems you need to make a
video of your interactive content.

Regards,
Yihui

messages.author: c6ca7877bef91eef
messages.subject: Re: [knitr] knitr output within prezi?
parts:
I am the author of an R Package called Slidify, which supports ImpressJS, an open source slide framework with Prezi like effects.

You can see it in action here http://ramnathv.github.io/slidifyExamples/examples/impressjs/#/slide-1.

The source code is R Markdown, which can be found here https://github.com/ramnathv/slidifyExamples/blob/gh-pages/examples/impressjs/index.Rmd

With Slidify/ImpressJS, it is possible to embed any arbitrary HTML content including charts.

Best,
Ramnath
